profile.headline: Software Engineer | React | React Native | TypeScript
profile.summary:
I'm a front-end focused Mid-Level Software Engineer with hands-on experience building responsive, user-friendly web and mobile applications from the ground up. I've worked with tools like React, React Native, TypeScript, Node.js, and Angular to develop scalable solutions across startups as well as enterprise environments.

I've contributed to projects involving full-stack development, CI/CD workflows, and cross-functional collaboration. 

Passionate about creating intuitive digital experiences and continuously leveling up my skills, one application at a time.

I also built and launched a cross-platform mobile application end-to-end using React Native, Expo, and Firebase, now live on the App store and Google Play with over 200 users globally!

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
Build and maintain mobile and web applications under the Moore Apps software portfolio, translating business requirements into technical specifications and component designs. Deployed a multi-platform ecosystem (“The Prayer App”), delivering a cross-platform iOS/Android mobile application (React Native/Expo) from concept to live release on App Store & Google Play. 

Developed a responsive product web application utilizing semantic HTML and fluid CSS layouts to ensure complete mobile optimization, and accessible rendering across all modern browsers. 

Implemented a subscription monetization system featuring multi-tier pricing, progressive ad serving, usage-based feature gating, and token-based RESTful API authentication and error handling. 

Integrated cloud-based text-to-speech with premium voice models, optimizing audio streams and media playback systems to ensure stable performance across various devices. 

Programmed a push notification system with scheduled and behavioral triggers, comprehensive user onboarding flow, and custom dynamic theme styling. 

Manage end-to-end technical submission, compliance verification, unit testing, and CI/CD deployment pipelines for production application releases.
positions.insights: Skills: React Native · Firebase · Software Development · API

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained front-end features for dealership-facing applications using React, TypeScript, and React Native

- Migrated an existing web-based React project into a modern React Native mobile codebase, refactoring legacy components and adapting them for mobile UI/UX

- Built an interactive map feature using
HERE Maps API to show nearby EV charging stations, with search and location filtering functionality

- Wired up front-end components with backend API endpoints, to align with Swagger-defined specifications, and tested request/response behavior in Postman to ensure consistent data flow.

- Created reusable front-end components to support consistency across the mobile app

- Authored technical documentation to support internal API evaluations

- Participated in sprint planning by providing user story estimates based on complexity, and reviewed pull requests for quality assurance
positions.insights: Skills: API · React Native · React.js · TypeScript · Problem Solving · Front-end Development

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Delivered front-end and mobile features across four projects - three external client projects and one internal product - using React, TypeScript, Angular, Redux, Expo, and React Native.

- Contributed to backend development - REST API endpoints, services, DTOs in Node.js, TypeScript and PostgreSQL. Practiced CI/CD workflows using CircleCI; participated in sprint planning, wrote user stories, conducted code reviews.

- Delivered full lifecycle development of an Angular admin website for the city of Bakersfield, featuring Spanish localization, role-based access, dynamic routing, and responsive layouts. 

- Tested API endpoints in Postman during development of backend features to validate request structure and data handling. Built reusable UI components including match card views for a mobile dating app, long-press user reporting, dark mode modals, and implemented front-end notification badge counts with app state detection.
positions.insights: Skills: React Native · TypeScript · Problem Solving · JavaScript · Code Review

positions.title: Junior Java Developer
positions.description:
Oct 2018  - Feb 2019
- Collaborated on an Agile team to assist with maintaining a custom-built, internal wire fraud web application using Ruby and SQL. Wrote user stories, and used Jira and Kanban boards. Learned about transactional banking, fraud detection, and prevention. 

Feb 2019 - June 2019
Collaborated on a Scrum team to maintain an internal admin web application using Java, Spring MVC, Maven, and SQuirrel SQL
- Assisted with bug fixes, queried and updated existing SQL tables, deployed DEV/QA code changes using Jenkins
- Tailed server logs using Citrix Xen app to resolve technical issues, reduced technical debt, and assisted with manual regression testing

positions.title: Manual Clear Coat Technician
positions.description:
- Inspected vehicles in clear coat booth to assess for possible paint defects 
- Manually sprayed vehicles that were shy of clear coat paint using hand held clear coat paint gun 
-Completed Kaizen’s to improve workplace environment by reducing safety hazards
- Also worked on numerous jobs within the paint, material, trim, and final/shipping departments

positions.title: Production Intern
positions.description:
- Logged video times & descriptions, researched archived video footage, transcribed video footage and audio clips
- Wrote weekly summary of the public affairs program Flash Point, which was complied into the FCC quarterly programing report for WDIV
- Worked directly under producer to assist with guest interviews, production meetings, and field production shoots
- Production Assistant for America's 87th Thanksgiving Parade
- Production Assistant for Hob Nobble Gobble

positions.title: Production Assistant
positions.description: Production Assistant for six episodes. Also assisted with show run down, and guest facilitation.
